method: Closed-loop concurrent workers, 10 searches each; alternating CS staff/student. Unique synthetic query suffix avoids exact-query cache hits. HTTP JSON-RPC tools/call on stateless MCP; pooled connections; 30s timeout. Document scope checked after each timed stage. Not a single-instance or cold-start benchmark.

cloudObservations.notes: Cloud metrics can arrive late; distinct instances per stage is not peak concurrent instances. CPU/memory distribution means are sampled aggregates.
